definition.confidence_pct: Engineering confidence that the diagnosed gap is real, based on static/dynamic evidence; not a statistical probability.
definition.improvement_potential_pct: Engineering estimate of expected gameplay/system improvement if correctly implemented; not an A/B-tested probability.

findings.title: Eventos não fecham cadeias causais entre módulos
findings.evidence: Kill/hunt reached lifecycle/social/ecology only through explicit session adapters; runtime EventBus has automatic subscription only in ConsequenceEngine and no packaged domain rule set.
findings.correction: Create DomainIntegrationHub with typed idempotent adapters: ENTITY_DIED -> ecology aggregate, corpse/loot, witness/social, legal/faction, economy/resource; ROUTE_CHANGED -> logistics/economy/population/faction.

findings.title: Não existe ciclo nativo dinheiro → vendedor → item → inventário
findings.evidence: Runtime has no currency/wallet/vendor/shop/retail subsystem; WPN-003 purchase in hunt required runtime session policy. Master weapons provide relative_cost but no numeric price.
findings.correction: Add ItemInstance + Inventory + Wallet/Ledger + VendorStock + Transaction + PriceQuote services. Keep mutable numeric prices runtime-only.
findings.authorial_note: Currency names/denominations require author decision if they are to become canon.

findings.title: Custo relativo não é convertido em preço local auditável
findings.evidence: All 30 MAR weapons use relative_cost tiers (10 BAIXO, 10 MÉDIO, 10 ALTO); no numeric price exists; prior session had to invent LOW=30.
findings.correction: PriceResolver: base_value_index(relative_cost) × local_market × scarcity × logistics × regulation × item_condition × relationship. Return breakdown and emit PRICE_QUOTED/TRADE_COMPLETED events.

findings.title: MAR não está ligado a combate, dano ou saúde
findings.evidence: Static runtime scan: no native combat/health/armor/ammo/durability systems and no MAR loader; hunt used validated lethal runtime policy.
findings.correction: Add CombatResolver + VitalityComponent + DamagePacket + Defense/Status + death/nonlethal transitions; map MAR performance/function/maintenance into runtime item stats without mutating Master.

findings.title: Indivíduos e população agregada divergem
findings.evidence: Dynamic tests: reproduction materialized 1 child but aggregate stayed 12; individual migration TER-011→TER-001 left aggregates 12 and 3 unchanged; prior individual death also did not decrement aggregate.
findings.correction: Add EcologyPopulationReconciler subscribed to ANIMAL_BORN/ANIMAL_DIED/MIGRATION_COMPLETED; enforce invariant aggregate == reconciled living individuals + abstract population ledger.

findings.title: Demanda econômica não encontra população local
findings.evidence: 0 of 7 canonical economic-flow destinations match POPULATION_AGGREGATE refs; _population_factor falls back to 1.0 for all seven destinations.
findings.correction: Resolve POI/INDN destination -> settlement/territory via Atlas bindings, then compute demand by served population and consumer_scope. Remove silent default or emit diagnostic when unresolved.

findings.title: Escassez não distingue alimento de outros produtos nem localidade
findings.evidence: Controlled test set FLOW-003 componentes de rede shortage=100; food_security became 85.7143 identically in all 14 settlements. Population tick averages shortage of every flow globally.
findings.correction: Introduce product_need_class and locality matrix. Food products affect food_security, medicines affect health_access, industrial components affect infrastructure/production, etc., only in served regions.

findings.title: Fuga/patrulha e viagens não possuem deslocamento espacial completo
findings.evidence: Prior hunt ECO_FLEE consumed energy but witness remained BIO-008. Static runtime has no travel/pathfinding subsystem.
findings.correction: Add MovementSystem using Atlas route graph/territory adjacency; ECO_FLEE chooses safe reachable node, PATROL traverses waypoints, player/NPC travel consumes universe time and resources.

findings.title: Modelo rico de rotas é reduzido a operacional/capacidade
findings.evidence: Master routes expose distance_km, speed_bands, estimated_time, terrain, access_level, infrastructure, maintenance and risk; runtime route state sample stores only route_ref, operational, capacity_factor, risk, authority, while economy uses only capacity/operational.
findings.correction: RouteSimulation adapter: travel_time, freight_cost, risk_loss, access permissions, maintenance degradation and transport-mode compatibility feed economy and movement.

findings.title: Animais não envelhecem nem acumulam fome/sede com o tempo
findings.evidence: Dynamic orchestrator: after 24 ticks/day, age_days 30→30, hunger 20→20, thirst 20→20; energy changed only from actions.
findings.correction: Metabolism/Aging tick driven by species profile, biome/climate and activity; advance age, hunger, thirst, fatigue, recovery, mortality risk and reproduction windows.

findings.title: Entidade morta continua sendo agendada
findings.evidence: After animal lifecycle DEAD, two following orchestration ticks still selected it and returned REJECTED ValidationError; participant remained enabled=true.
findings.correction: Auto-disable/unregister terminal lifecycle participants and provide explicit scheduler lifecycle API; invariant: DEAD/DESTROYED cannot remain active participant unless a corpse/recovery role requires it.

findings.title: Testemunhar eventos não é automático
findings.evidence: Dynamic test: observer in same location had memories 0→0 after an authoritative event; witness_event exists but requires explicit call.
findings.correction: Perception/WitnessService calculates visibility/hearing/context, subscribes to events, dispatches verified/rumor memories and social effects subject to spoiler/privacy rules.

findings.title: Relações de facção existem no banco mas são sistemicamente inertes
findings.evidence: world_systems creates/sets/integrity-checks faction_relations_runtime but faction tick does not read relations. Treasury gain uses global economic activity divided equally among all factions.
findings.correction: Local faction ledger: taxes/revenue/control from relevant territories/markets/routes; relations alter trade, security, access, conflict and cooperation; consume reputation/social outcomes.

findings.title: Morte e colheita não fecham cadeia de recursos
findings.evidence: Predator death produced no loot/corpse. HARVEST decreases resource_quantity but no native inventory item is materialized.
findings.correction: ResourceYield/Corpse system: species/resource yield profiles, item materialization, ownership, decay, harvesting, processing and economic injection. Do not invent species drops where canon has none; use authorial/runtime proposal layer.

findings.title: Motores de consequência e memória não vêm com política de integração de domínio
findings.evidence: Production modules expose register_rule and register_effect_policy APIs, but static audit found no packaged default domain registrations outside the defining modules/tests.
findings.correction: Versioned LivingIntegrationPolicyPack loaded per world, with dependency graph, priorities, idempotency keys, rollback-safe post-commit handlers and invariant tests.

findings.title: Seeds universais tornam territórios economicamente/faccionalmente parecidos
findings.evidence: Dynamic bootstrap: all 7 flows share stock100/production20/consumption15/base_price10; all 14 populations count1000; all 3 factions influence50/treasury1000/security50/stability50.
findings.correction: Deterministic RuntimeSeedProfiles derived from qualitative canonical signals (density/capacity, presence_type, route connectivity, industry, resource zones), with seed recorded for reproducibility.

findings.title: Dados MAR de manutenção não geram desgaste/condição
findings.evidence: Master MAR contains maintenance/supply/performance detail, but runtime scan found no durability/repair subsystem and no MAR integration.
findings.correction: Item condition/durability model with wear by use/environment, maintenance requirements, repair professions/materials, resale effect and failure states.

findings.title: Ações violentas não chegam a lei, reputação ou permissões
findings.evidence: Predator kill triggered no bounty/crime/reputation/faction consequence; runtime has social reputation primitives but no legal/bounty/law subsystem.
findings.correction: Territorial Norm/Law system linked to species protection, hunting rights, witnesses, faction authority and reputation. Laws themselves require authorial/canonical source or explicit runtime policy.

findings.title: Reprodução genérica ignora compatibilidade biológica
findings.evidence: Dynamic test: two CRI-002 animals with sex UNSPECIFIED reproduced successfully; current generic checks focus on species/maturity/co-location/drive.
findings.correction: Species reproductive_mode and compatibility policy (sexual/asexual/spore/budding/etc.) with optional sex, season, pair-bond, fertility and gestation constraints.

findings.title: 91 profissões canônicas quase não participam do runtime econômico
findings.evidence: Runtime scan only references PROFESSION as a reputation scope; no profession/skill production subsystem was found, while Master release validates 91 professions.
findings.correction: ProfessionCapability layer connecting agents/population labor to production, repair, trade, medical, institutional and crafting tasks; preserve qualifications and spatial bindings from Master.

findings.title: Ambiente reativo não forma ainda um sistema ambiental mundial
findings.evidence: ObjectEnvironment handles heat/wet/fire/object reactions, but runtime static scan has no weather/disease system and ecology decisions are not automatically fed by global environmental state.
findings.correction: EnvironmentalState layer per biome/region/time feeding objects, fauna, flora, travel and population; weather can remain runtime-generated under canonical climate bounds.

findings.title: Recuperação universal de 7 dias pode reduzir diferenciação ecológica
findings.evidence: Core authorial fail-safe schedules exactly 7 universe days for destroyed STRUCTURE, OBJECT, FLORA_INSTANCE and RESOURCE_NODE. This is protected behavior, not a bug.
findings.correction: Do not change silently. If author wants more ecology depth, preserve 7-day structural rule where required and approve per-kind recovery policy/regen curves in a future canonical decision.
